description.value: Radium Chalet is a chalet-style accommodation in the Radium Hot Springs area of the Kootenays, British Columbia. Located on Madsen Road, it sits near the hot springs and the entrance to Kootenay National Park, a region popular with touring cyclists riding the Columbia Valley or Banff-to-Radium routes. No current web presence could be verified to provide further detail.
